coordinate_reporting.authority: this local plane is canonical for the report
coordinate_reporting.cpa: for p->q: u=clamp(-dot(p,q-p)/dot(q-p,q-p),0,1); use the least-distance point; exact ties select earlier UTC

closest_approach.distance_m: local-plane metres, nearest 0.1 metre, half away from zero
closest_approach.mmsi: the matched radar identity expressed as its MMSI
closest_approach.utc: radar segment CPA, nearest second with exact half toward the earlier second

divergence.ais_minus_radar_east_m_north_m: metres, nearest metre, half away from zero
divergence.start_utc_end_utc: first and last UTC samples of the residual-derived run

report.radar_utc_offset_minutes: signed integer copied from the radar header after normalization by subtraction
